items.briefing:
A new report highlights a growing gap between AI adoption and proper governance practices, with many organisations rushing to use AI tools without adequate security or compliance controls in place. This is relevant for Australian RTOs using AI in training delivery or administration. Separately, Interpol has activated its global payment interception system to help cut off fraud transactions — a reminder that financial scams remain a significant international threat.

Phishing attacks continue to be detected at high rates, with honeypot research catching targeted campaigns almost immediately upon deployment. If staff receive unexpected emails requesting login details or payments, verify the request through a separate, known contact method before acting.

featured.quote: ACMA sues Optus over 2025 Triple Zero outage, setting precedent for telecom accountability.
